name: webfetch
description: Fetch a web page or URL and return its readable text. Use this when the user pastes a URL and wants its content, when you want to read an article or page in full (e.g. after websearch returns a result worth following), or when the user asks you to 'read' or 'summarise' something at a specific URL. Returns the page title, final URL (after redirects), and readable prose — scripts and markup stripped. Only http and https URLs are supported.

url.description: The http or https URL to fetch.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of body text to return (default 8000, max 20000).
